coordination.observed_latest_f2_commit: trigger6: atomically claim AgentSight HTTP1 E3 falsifier
coordination.rule: This reconciliation does not execute or compete for the claimed E3 falsifier. It only fuses already-landed source evidence.

shared_findings: AgentSight is pinned to eunomia-bpf/agentsight commit 934f441eff8ca210807333633f47b2efcb8cd020 / release 1.0.30 / MIT.
Current evidence reaches E2 architecture mapping only; source inspection does not grant runtime, build-candidate, F2 acceptance, EntityOS/HCU, or training credit.
Highest-value role is independent read-only witness for process/file/network/resource/tool activity, not canonical state or effect authority.
Full eBPF/TLS capture is Linux/privilege/version sensitive and can expose sensitive payloads.
AgentSight-derived correlation and timestamps do not automatically establish F2 causal identity.
F2-native telemetry is a serious counterhypothesis and may provide sufficient coverage with lower privilege/dependency/privacy cost.
unique_findings_preserved: One audit identifies AgentSight row lineage fields such as view_source/confidence and tool_call_id/related_pid/related_event_id as useful foreign-witness metadata, but not F2 identity.
One audit distinguishes kernel/view evidence from agent_native_session fallback and requires that fallback never be relabeled as kernel-observed.
One audit records boot-relative kernel timestamps and the need to measure timestamp reconciliation error.

One audit checks the upstream overhead slogan and finds that the reported arithmetic average can be about 2.9 percent while individual benchmark rows exceed 3 percent; no blanket sub-3-percent F2 claim is admitted.
AgentSight MaterializedView and optional SQLite/OTel sinks are useful derived read models/export surfaces, but importing them as operational truth would create a second authority boundary.

The current F2 telemetry contract already requires stable run/causal identity, UNKNOWN rather than guessed attribution, immutable run packages, and explicit source coverage; an AgentSight adapter must conform to those constraints rather than redefine them.

current_facing_decision.storage_rule: AgentSight MaterializedView/SQLite/OTel output remains derived external evidence. UnifiedDB/F2 canonical evidence contracts and immutable run packages remain authoritative; AgentSight storage is never a second truth store.
current_facing_decision.effect_rule: AgentSight can witness candidate external behavior and disagreements but cannot mint EffectGate/EffectJournal outcomes, semantic completion, or successful world effects.
current_facing_decision.identity_rule: Import only explicitly typed witness references with exact source pin, run identity, process identity, provenance class, time basis, and UNKNOWN on unresolved joins; never guess causal_id/invocation_id/effect_id.
current_facing_decision.privacy_rule: Default future evaluation to nonsecret synthetic payloads and minimal retained fields; TLS plaintext capture is not a routine-production default.

preferred_sequence: First reproduce one bounded upstream visibility claim on an exact-bound nonsecret HTTP/1 or synthetic fixture under the existing atomic claim.
Then, only if E3 is positive, compare F2-native telemetry alone versus F2 plus a read-only AgentSight witness on identical ground-truth parent/child/file/network/resource workload.

Measure event precision/recall, unique coverage gain, false causal attribution under overlapping children, timestamp reconciliation error, CPU/RSS/I/O and p50/p95/p99 latency overhead, privilege failure behavior, and sensitive-data exposure.
Reject or downgrade to METHOD_DESIGN_DONOR_ONLY if unique information gain is negligible or identity/privilege/privacy cost dominates.

history_policy.reason: Parallel files are preserved as provenance and independent source-reading history.
history_policy.current_facing_rule: Use this reconciliation for the consolidated E2 decision; consult inputs for unique evidence details and contradictions.

mirror.policy: Append-only two-repository mirror; if one side fails, mark MIRROR_DIVERGED rather than overwriting history.
